title: Malaysia Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Country climate-development assessment; observed subnational vulnerabilities and policy recommendations, with modeled future impacts.
methodology: Country assessment using sector analysis, biophysical modeling and government and civil-society consultations.
limitations: Recommendations are not evaluated outcomes; district averages mask local variation.

title: Governing Climate Risks as National Security Priority: Call to Re-examine Malaysia’s Reactive Approach to Environmental Hazards
organization: Institute of Strategic & International Studies (ISIS) Malaysia
temporal_coverage: Research note published in 2026; displacement examples from 2021-24 and conditional future risks.
methodology: Research note synthesizes a 2025 conference, roundtable, official data and published studies.
limitations: Qualitative synthesis; conditional pathways are not measured local violence.

title: Balancing Innovation and Coordination: Institutional Solutions for Effective Climate Action in Malaysia’s Borneo States — Subnational Climate Change Institutional Assessment Overview
organization: World Bank Group, with Sarawak Ministry of Energy and Environmental Sustainability and Sabah Forestry Department
temporal_coverage: Institutional overview published March 2026; describes state structures, tools and capacity constraints.
methodology: State assessment based on institutional review and engagement with government agencies.
limitations: Overview covers Sabah and Sarawak state functions, not national adaptation outcomes.

title: Coping with Climate Change: OECD Economic Surveys: Malaysia 2026
organization: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
temporal_coverage: 2026 economic survey chapter; includes first-half 2026 agricultural impacts and current policy status.
methodology: Country economic survey chapter synthesizing official statistics and cited research.
limitations: Some event and projection findings are cited from other institutions.
